visualCharacteristics.purpose: image (and optional text) slides with prev/next buttons and dot indicators below the slides, keyboard accessible (left/right arrow keys when the carousel has focus)
visualCharacteristics.description: Base: slides fill the width at min(50vw, viewport minus nav); controls bar below with centred dots and prev/next arrows on the right; controls only with 2+ slides. hero-img: full-width image 400px tall (object-fit cover) at all widths, black arrow buttons bottom right below the image, 10px round dots, controls shown even with a single slide.

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide; cell 1 = image, optional cell 2 = slide content (dropped when empty, extra cells merged into it); empty rows are skipped

usage: Hero image slideshow at the top of adventure detail pages, e.g. https://wknd.site/us/en/adventures/bali-surf-camp.html (1 to 3 image-only slides).
reuseGuidance: Use Carousel (Hero Img) for full-width image-only page heroes that keep their controls even with one slide. Use the plain carousel for slides with overlay text where controls only matter with several slides.
